title: Use invariant node types and verify the active render path
environment: Blender 5.2.1 observed material graph. Transparent paths and multiple engine-specific outputs were not covered.
goal: Construct textured material graphs in more than one UI locale.
approach: Historical failed assumption: Built-in display names and the mere presence of images/nodes were treated as stable rendering evidence.
what_worked: Historical correction: Select nodes by invariant type, prefer the active output and its connected shader, and explicitly establish the active Surface link. Verification reported by the source: English/Japanese controls each reached 48/48 active surfaces with no duplicate outputs. Separate-process reopen preserved graph signatures and 147 slot bindings. Manual viewport preview was not verified in this recorded checkpoint.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: English-name lookups failed under Japanese UI, creating duplicate shader/output nodes; none of 48 texture chains reached the active output.
why: Confirmed: localized names defeated lookup, and new links reached an inactive sink.
improved_method: Address built-in nodes by invariant identifiers. Test graph reachability to the active sink, including nondefault locales and save/reopen.
when_to_use: Blender 5.2.1 observed material graph. Transparent paths and multiple engine-specific outputs were not covered.
when_not_to_use: Transparent paths and multiple engine-specific outputs were not covered.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
